storyInfo: Despite the workers' opposition, Lupina has no choice but to sell the family winery she inherited.

attributes.content: Lupina, here is the bill of lading for this order of your winery's grapes by Saluzzo Vino.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You can look over the details.
attributes.name: Elio
Lupina
attributes.content: Let me see—

attributes.name: Lupina
attributes.content: Everything seems to be in order. You're always on top of things.
I'm flattered.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Lupina... there is something which I'm not sure I should ask, in my position.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Why the formality?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Go ahead, Zio Elio. We've known each other for so long.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Ever since Kazimierzian wine entered the market—
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You've been running a surplus of grapes at your winery, which has been good for us...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Your prices are reasonable, and it helps us clear inventory. It's a deal that benefits both sides.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Yes... but the amount that you're offering in this batch...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Is it too much for you?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: No, no, we use all the grapes we can get. But are you leaving any for your own wine production?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You can tell?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Lupina...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Golden Prairie approached us a little while back.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: They offered to buy the Verdi Winery... and they made an offer I couldn't refuse.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The winery is going under, despite our best efforts...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: At least Golden Prairie's interest shows that our equipment and vineyards are worth something.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Thank you for everything, Zio Elio. Saluzzo Vino has always been a good partner to the Verdi Winery.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: But... what about the other guys? Davide? What about Niccolo? Did he agree?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: ...I'll convince them.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: No, Lupina! How could we sell our Verdi Winery to the Kazimierzians?
Calm down, Niccolo. Let's sit down and talk about this. There's wine, and there's food.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: What's that...?
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Our signature wine, Sangiovese. You know it well, don't you?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Yes... I remember this label. Old Verdi, your nonno, painted it himself.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I was raising the grapes when he first developed this wine!
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Trimmed them vine by vine myself. The clippers were heavy and unwieldy, especially in winter, when you're out all day in the cold.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: But it was worth it. These vines are older than all of us put together.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: In Kazimierz, they trim their vines with machines, so they can go through a whole vineyard in a single day.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It's not the same. Those stupido machines rip the vines apart. It may save time in the short term, but the grapes don't have long to live once they're done with them.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: They don't know how to trim along the grain of the vine, ensuring that the fruits get proper sunlight and develop the right flavor...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: You kids don't know the old Siracusan craft, and no one wants to learn anymore.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: The Siracusan wine is unique because every vine is as old as the famiglie.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Caring for a grapevine is like caring for family. At least, it was for your nonno.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Niccolo...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Think about it, Lupa. Every grape in Verdi Winery is picked from a vine older than your nonno.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Workers like us have spent our whole lives picking grapes, carrying barrels, making wine.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: My son inherited my craft. Even my granddaughter is selling wine for the winery.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Where will we go, if the winery is sold?
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I'll make sure everyone is taken care of. Your skills won't go to waste.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I—would the family we've built here still exist, after the winery is sold and all the workers have gone their separate ways?
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: To me, it's better to die with dignity now, than to continue to try to scrape by in Nuova Volsinii. Give it a decent ending, while this land still has value.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Severance will be paid according to our contract terms.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It's not the severance I'm worried about!
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: You were never all that interested in running the winery, but don't you feel anything for this place old Verdi kept running all those years?
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Nonno wouldn't want his winery to go bankrupt. It's not such a bad thing to find a new home for it. This is Nuova Volsinii, Niccolo, and it's time we accepted the new order.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The old worker stays silent for a while.
Finally, he takes out an invitation from his pocket and puts it on the table.
What's that...?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: My granddaughter Betti turns ten next week. We'll do this by the old rules of Siracusa.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: She's ten already? I'll have to—
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I'm leaving.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: At a small, unremarkable home in a quiet alley.
It is already late when Lupina arrives.
A warm light greets her as she opens the door.
I knew I'd find you here.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: This is my private bar. You'll always find me here when I'm free.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Here, your usual. One Tramonto with extra orange juice, less syrup, and six cubes of ice.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I thought you'd be busier.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The Kazimierzians' Red Wine Championship is in just a few days. Golden Prairie sent out an invitation to all the local wineries.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: We're not really in a position to participate... but I suppose you'll be there?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It's a marketing opportunity, no matter who's organizing it.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Yes, it is an opportunity.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But I've made the necessary arrangements. I don't need to be there personally, for the rest.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You prefer to hide here and mix drinks at your leisure?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Just a little hobby of mine. You have your hobbies too, don't you?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Would you care to check the drum set over there for me, my dear vintner?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: She sits down in the drummer's chair and starts banging out a lively rhythm.
Her foot stomps steadily on the cymbal pedal, while the movements of the drumsticks in her hands are clean and confident.
'Se muoio in guerra, seppellitemi con un fiorino, versa le lacrime di mamma, sulla mia tomba come vino...'
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: A song that every Siracusan child knows. You've brought it to Nuova Volsinii.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: An arrangement. The original is too melancholic for this occasion.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The streets are filled with vibrant Kazimierzian wine ads. A Siracusan must learn to read the room.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Maybe not all the time.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Elio told you about our winery.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: That's what you're here for.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: What's your plan?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: The Kazimierzians are coming to audit the assets tomorrow. I've already signed the letter of intent to sell.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: There weren't many workers left by the time papá took over from nonno. There's no point in carrying on.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Traditional winemaking methods are time- and labor-intensive. The winery was operating at a loss by the time papá passed it to me.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: A shame. But since you've already made your decision—what do you need from me?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: It's not like you to hesitate.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: The remaining workers... they're all skilled veterans. They'll do well no matter where they go.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Saluzzo Vino has dozens of wineries under your label. There must be places that could use a pair of skilled hands.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I'm not trying to force them on you.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I know the famiglie's rules. You will be doing me a huge favor, one that I'm not in a position to repay.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Just give them a chance, check them out and assign them based on your assessment and needs...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Nothing to be nervous about.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: It's only natural that you'd want to take care of your family. And I do need to hire more hands.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Grazie.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: All's well with the workers, but what about you?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Me? I guess I'll... chase my dreams in music?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Frankly, I think I'm a much better drummer than I am a vintner.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The feigned nonchalance is accompanied by a series of drum riffs.
They echo in this little private bar, never leaving the room.
I... can't... I can't just...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Who's there? Elio... you're still here?
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Let me help.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: It's so quiet... I can hear the ringing in my ears.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: This used to be a lively place... the sounds of footsteps, barrels rolling, metal and glass clanging against each other, bubbles sizzling while grapes ferment...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: And now, it's all...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: There is only silence left.
Lupina slowly walks past the warehouse, the cellar, the vat.
She knows this may be the last time she makes these checks.
Her hand touches the antiquated equipment, the marks of age—
The handle of the presser falls off the screw.
No... the Kazimierzian auditor is coming soon! How could my equipment break at a time like this?!
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Oh, this stubborn old stuff... got to screw it back—
attributes.name: Lupina
Lupina
attributes.content: Ought to be just like a lightbulb—

attributes.name: Lupina
attributes.content: It's stuck?
Lupina...
Davide? Good timing! Come, help me fix this thing.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The vertical screw is completely stripped. It won't go back on.
attributes.name: Davide

attributes.content: I was just going to tell you, I was doing my regular checks when I found a problem with the filtration system's hydraulic cylinder.
attributes.name: Davide

attributes.content: It's cracked and can't maintain hydraulic pressure.
attributes.name: Davide

attributes.content: Lupa, the Kazimierzians are here.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: A fine classic villa, Signorina Verdi. The wolf's head on the wine barrels is quite detailed, and even the stone tiles in the cellar are tastefully ornamented.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: It was my grandfather who painted them.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Shall we discuss what to do with your family's artwork? Would you like us to remove it intact and return it to you, or include it in the purchase?
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Remove it?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Since the paintings on the tiles are the work of your late grandfather, we can arrange for an art preservation expert to remove them for you, should you wish. I assure you, they will not be damaged.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Oh, then yes, please.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The expert's fee will be at your own expense, of course.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: I knew it... fine, I'll pay. Please make sure the tiles are removed intact and undamaged.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Shall we proceed to the next item?
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Alright...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Crusher, fermentation tank, presser, thermostat, filtration system... you have a full complement of winemaking equipment.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Yes, it was my grandfather who procured it. They were the most popular models at the time... very durable.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Your grandfather? That was a while ago, then.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Still, it works well. Please, come and see our crusher.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: This machine crushes grapes with minimal loss. My grandfather retrofitted it with extra-wide rollers, increasing production by—
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: There seems to be an issue with the sealing ring on the machine's connector, if I'm not mistaken?
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Equipment assessment is not my specialty, but I am under the impression that the sealing ring should not be exposed.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: And your thermostat... I took note of the temperature reading when I passed it. The temperature seems suboptimal for winemaking.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Well... yes, the equipment may be a little old.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: But our workers maintain it regularly, and we have all the necessary spare parts on hand. We can get it repaired quickly.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It will not affect delivery.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Ah, if that is what you're concerned about, there is no need to worry.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Your equipment was not included in our initial assessment.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Traditional Siracusan equipment is inefficient and incompatible with our production lines. We did not intend to keep it to begin with. You may dispose of it as you see fit.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: This includes the oaken casks in the warehouse that you showed me—
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: These handmade casks create uncontrolled impurities in the storage process, which are detrimental to quality control for mass-produced wine.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: You don't use oaken casks?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: We have replaced traditional oaken casks with steel containers, which have better hermetic properties and are more responsive to temperature control.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: It'll lose a lot of flavor—
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Merda, I sound like my nonno.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: That will be a question for our inspector to worry about. I suggest you focus on whether the offer meets your expectations.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: I assure you that you have nothing to worry about.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: It is the land on which your winery sits that we are interested in. We will offer a fair price for it.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: We get a plot of excellent land, while you receive a reasonable payment in turn. It's a win-win arrangement.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: I will document the results of the audit, then our legal representative will contact you to finalize the contract.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Please reach out to her if you have any questions.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: Would you like to try a sip?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: If I recall correctly, we bought out Verdi Winery's inventory last month, as you were in urgent need of liquidity to make payroll.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: There will be no need to see me out. Have a nice day, Signorina Verdi.
attributes.name: Auditor

attributes.content: The Kazimierzian leaves the winery with his briefcase, takes one glance at the lonely vineyard, then gets into a black car that has been waiting for him outside.
It takes a long while, until the sound of the car's engine is long gone, for Lupina to come to her senses.
It's over. Nonno's winery sold, just like that...
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I thought... they would care more about our traditions and equipment...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Niccolo.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The presser and crusher, the thermostat and filtration system—
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I was the one who broke them.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I know. I'm not here to blame anyone.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: You've been here so many years. I doubt you thought breaking a few piece of equipment would stop the purchase.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I just...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: Hoped that they would stay?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The pipes... Elio...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: He did something else?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I wanted to stop him, but...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I understand your anger... what's done is done. if the auditor didn't find it, there's no reason for us to tell them.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Lupa...
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I wasn't much of a businesswoman, but I know how to tell a good guy from a bad one.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: That drunk papá of mine wasn't even born when you started working at the winery with my nonno.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: You know, he used to measure my height with this presser. See the lines on the cylinder?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It's for the best that it broke. At least it couldn't be sold.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Verdi Winery was my entire life. I watched every new bottle go out the door, saw us weather one storm after another.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: I thought my granddaughter, or maybe my grandddaughter's granddaughter, would get to see the new bottles going out... I didn't think it would end this way.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: If continuing the old ways won't protect them, maybe this is for the best.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: ...Is there anything else I can do?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: My son would like you to come to his daughter's tenth birthday party.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: With a bottle of wine her age, as is tradition.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: But—
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: And take good care of this winery, until it really changes hands, mio caro Lupa.
attributes.name: Niccolo

attributes.content: 'My dear vintner, I would very much appreciate if you would pay a visit to my private bar. You may help yourself to my collection.'
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: He told me to come, but he's nowhere to be found.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: People in Siracusa die every day. How's that enough to shut him up at home?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: And he wants his guests to mix their own drinks...?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: It's been a long time since I've done it... what was it that nonno said?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.text: Winemaking is a slow and gradual process. The wine begins to gain its unique flavor during fermentation, like a family slowly brought together.
Sometimes, wines and juices of different flavors are mixed together before being presented for tasting.
No, you're too young to drink.
That's a paintbrush, not a drumstick... I'm not done painting yet—
Yes, you can play with it once I'm done. Look, this is our vineyard. This big wolf head is me, and the small one is you.
You want to paint a couple of brushes too?
Two drumsticks? My, my, mio caro Lupa sure has her own ideas.
You want to be a musician, the most rhythmic drummer on Terra? Then nonno's gonna be the best painter on Terra! Haha!
No, I'm not angry. See? I'm painting right now, on a wine bottle—
I'll take you to the cellar when it gets warmer and decorate the walls. I've wanted to do this for a long time. It took years just for the idea to take shape.
I want you to both inherit the winery, and have the freedom to become a musician.
Your family should not make you give up your dreams.

attributes.content: Guess it's come to this, nonno.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: I couldn't even come up with a bottle from this year.
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: Maybe a bit of music to lift the mood?
attributes.name: Lupina

attributes.content: The drummer walks to the instrument.
There is a finely wrapped gift box on the stool on which she has often sat. She lays down her drumsticks, opens the ribbon-wrapped gift box, and finds a bottle of wine within.
The label features two wolf's heads by the grapevines, one large, one small, with two drumsticks by the ears of the smaller wolf drawn with childish lines.
The label says, 'Verdi 1092'.
The drummer lays her hand on the bottle gently, then puts it back inside the box and takes up the drumsticks. The sound of song begins to echo through the bar.
'Se muoio in guerra, seppellitemi con un fiorino, versa le lacrime di mamma, sulla mia tomba come vino...'
attributes.name: Lupina
